main_text.l: ne misso cucurbita satis amplam superim-
ponere,ut eliciat uirus. Atuerò qui in hoc
fagax Natura sponte in emissorium expu-
pustulas excitant, ut à praecordijs uirus a-
ualida sponte ducit. Quapropter si caput
opprimi cernatur: uel si alia cerebri male
affecti signa apparuerint, ut dolor capitis,
aut uertigo,aut delirium, uel aurium mur-
mur, uel faciei rubor cum temporum pul-
satione,& urina valde perspicua,in qua se-
alia his similia, tunc circa caput abscessum

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "sanguine" (the word after "& " is partly unclear, read as sanguine from context, but the printed form may differ); "certisimo" and "argumeto" are kept as printed; "Atuerò" has a grave accent that may be a printer's mark. Long s is rendered as s throughout (printed as f in places, e.g. "fed", "fcalpellaq", "fit"). The catchword "ad sca-" is partly unclear; the first letter may be f in print.
